name: Social Justice
overview: Scripture calls believers to uphold righteousness in judgment without partiality, ensuring fairness to both the poor and the mighty alike, as seen in Leviticus 19:15 and Deuteronomy 1:16. God demands justice that is free from falsehood and corruption, warning against unrighteous witness and wrong judgment (Exodus 23:1; Habakkuk 1:4). True obedience involves doing justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God (Micah 6:8), recognizing that each person bears responsibility for their own actions (Ezekiel 18:20).
